survey.method: Read-only: seven agents read every app's source and listed each interface part by kind, with how it is built, how often, its states and its accessibility.

batches.4: AI Research, Speculative Journalism and the rest (phases 6 and 7)

field.name: Field
field.what: A label, its control, a hint and an error, tied together.
field.mustGetRight: The label names the control (for and id); the hint and the error are read with it (aria-describedby); an error sets aria-invalid. The hint and the error share one place under the control, always there and two lines tall (--ds-slot-hint), so an error never moves the form. Nearly every app leaves labels untied.

slider.name: Slider
slider.what: A value on a range, with its number beside it: temperature, top K, a similarity cutoff.
slider.mustGetRight: A native range input with a visible label and an <output>; arrow keys step it. Never drawn on a canvas.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.what: A window over the page: information, an editor, or a confirmation before something cannot be undone.
dialog.mustGetRight: The native <dialog> with showModal(): focus moves in and stays, Escape closes, focus returns. A confirmation is role="alertdialog" and names what will happen. The browser's own alert() or confirm() stands in for one in about a dozen apps.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.what: Views of one thing, one shown at a time.
tabs.mustGetRight: role="tablist", tab and tabpanel; arrow keys move between tabs (roving tabindex), Home and End jump. Most apps' tabs work by click only.

disclosure.name: Disclosure
disclosure.what: A section that opens and closes: details, options, a report.
disclosure.mustGetRight: Native <details> and <summary>, or a button with aria-expanded. A clickable heading with an arrow is not enough.

notice.name: Notice
notice.what: A message in the page: an error, a warning, a note, a success, with an action when there is one (Try again).
notice.mustGetRight: The word says what kind it is; color only repeats it. A new error is announced (role="alert"); other news is role="status". It appears in a place kept for it, or as a toast over the page, so it never pushes the page down.

progress.name: Progress
progress.what: Something is happening: a busy ring while the length is unknown, a bar when it is known (n of N).
progress.mustGetRight: Words with it ("Writing…", "3 of 12"); role="progressbar" with values for the bar; announced when it starts and ends; still under prefers-reduced-motion. Its words and ring have their place kept (.ds-hold), so starting and ending move nothing.

empty-state.name: Empty state
empty-state.what: What a place says before it has anything: what will appear, and how to start.
empty-state.mustGetRight: Kept apart from loading and from "no match"; offers the next step when there is one.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.what: A short name or value on hover and focus: an icon button's name, a point on a chart.
tooltip.mustGetRight: Shown on focus as well as hover, dismissed with Escape, never the only place a thing is named. Nearly every app uses the title attribute alone, which a keyboard never sees.

card.name: Card
card.what: One item to open or pick: a demo, an agent, a session. A panel groups parts; a card is one thing.
card.mustGetRight: One link or button covers the card, one tab stop; a selected card says so (aria-current or aria-pressed).

code-block.name: Code block
code-block.what: Code, a command or a model's raw answer, set in mono.
code-block.mustGetRight: Wraps or scrolls inside itself, never the page; a scrolling block can be reached by keyboard.

copy-button.name: Copy button
copy-button.what: Copies a prompt, a link or a block, and says it did.
copy-button.mustGetRight: "Copied" is announced (role="status"), and a failure says what to do instead. "Copied" takes the place of "Copy" in a .ds-hold, so the button keeps its width.

legend.name: Legend
legend.what: The key to a figure's colors, marks and lines.
legend.mustGetRight: Each swatch has its words; a legend that also filters is a group of toggle buttons.

facts.name: Facts
facts.what: Name and value pairs: a run's record, a model's details.
facts.mustGetRight: A <dl>, so each value is read with its name.

fullscreen-button.name: Full screen button
fullscreen-button.what: Takes the page in and out of full screen; every page a room might see has one.
fullscreen-button.mustGetRight: Its name says which way it goes; hidden where the browser cannot go full screen.

file-drop.name: File drop
file-drop.what: Add a file by dropping, pasting or choosing it.
file-drop.mustGetRight: A real button to choose a file, so dropping is never the only way; what was added, or why not, is announced.

chat-thread.name: Chat thread
chat-thread.what: Turns between a person and a model, with a composer.
chat-thread.mustGetRight: The thread is role="log", so new replies are read; streaming, stopped and failed are said in words; Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line.

popover.name: Popover
popover.what: A small panel tied to a button: about this, a filter, a picker.
popover.mustGetRight: The native popover attribute: light dismiss and Escape; the button says it is open (aria-expanded).

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.what: A panel that slides in from an edge: a phone's navigation, settings, an inspector.
drawer.mustGetRight: Modal on a phone (focus in, Escape closes, focus returns); a side panel on a wide screen.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.what: An option that is on or off, alone or in a list.
checkbox.mustGetRight: A native checkbox inside its label; a disabled one says why (aria-describedby).

radio.name: Radio buttons
radio.what: One choice from a short list, each with words: a card type, a sort order.
radio.mustGetRight: Native radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>; arrow keys move the choice. A segmented control is for two to four short words.

toast.name: Toast
toast.what: Word that something finished somewhere else on the page: saved, added, failed.
toast.mustGetRight: role="status" (an error role="alert"); stays long enough to read; never the only record of an error. Six apps have none and use alert() or nothing.

menu.name: Menu
menu.what: Actions behind a button: ⋯, Load ▾, Versions. A <select> is for choosing a value; a menu is for doing something.
menu.mustGetRight: role="menu" and menuitem; arrow keys move, Escape closes and returns focus.

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.what: A field that suggests as you type: a model, an address.
combobox.mustGetRight: The ARIA combobox pattern: aria-expanded, a listbox, arrow keys, Enter to pick, Escape to close.

search-field.name: Search field
search-field.what: A field that filters what is shown, with a clear button.
search-field.mustGetRight: type="search" with a label (never a placeholder alone); the number of results is announced.

date-field.name: Date and time fields
date-field.what: The native date and time inputs, styled as fields.
date-field.mustGetRight: The browser's own picker; a label and the format in words.

link-button.name: Link button
link-button.what: An action that reads as a link: Clear, Forgot password?
link-button.mustGetRight: A <button> when it acts, an <a> when it goes somewhere, whatever it looks like.

count.name: Count
count.what: A number on a thing: members, results, n of 3 selected.
count.mustGetRight: Read with what it counts ("12 members"), not a bare number.

list-item.name: Selectable list
list-item.what: Rows you pick from: runs, revisions, scanned cards, sessions.
list-item.mustGetRight: Each row a button or link; the chosen one says so (aria-current or aria-selected); the current item has a rule in the margin, as in the rail.

sortable-table.name: Sortable table
sortable-table.mustGetRight: Each sortable header holds a button; aria-sort on the sorted column. In six apps a click on the header is the only way.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.what: Previous and next pages of a long list, or Load more.
pagination.mustGetRight: Names where it goes ("Page 3 of 9"); disabled at the ends; a nav with a label.

toolbar.name: Toolbar
toolbar.what: A row of tools for one area: undo, zoom, export.
toolbar.mustGetRight: role="toolbar" with a label; arrow keys move between its tools.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.what: A person's picture or initial beside their name.
avatar.mustGetRight: Decorative (alt="") when the name is beside it, which it always should be.

stat.name: Stat
stat.what: One number large with its name small: a readout, a total, a pass rate.
stat.mustGetRight: The name is read with the number; a changing readout is announced only when asked. A number that updates keeps its width: tabular figures (Archivo's are proportional), and its widest form held.

number-field.name: Number field
number-field.what: A number with its limits and step, and − and + where a pointer helps.
number-field.mustGetRight: type="number" with min, max and step; the − and + buttons are named.

color-field.name: Color field
color-field.what: A color, as a swatch with its value.
color-field.mustGetRight: The native color input with a label; the value in words beside it.

tree-view.name: Tree
tree-view.what: Nested items that open and close: a scene's nodes, a JSON document.
tree-view.mustGetRight: role="tree" and treeitem with aria-expanded; arrow keys move and open.

split-pane.name: Split pane
split-pane.what: Two panes with a divider you drag.
split-pane.mustGetRight: The divider is role="separator", takes focus, and moves with the arrow keys.

drag-handle.name: Drag handle
drag-handle.what: Something you move by dragging: a node, a panel, a block's edge.
drag-handle.mustGetRight: Every drag has a keyboard way too (arrow keys, or buttons to move up and down).

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.what: The shape of what is loading, held in place.
skeleton.mustGetRight: aria-busy on the region; the placeholders are hidden from screen readers; still under prefers-reduced-motion.

kbd.name: Keyboard hint
kbd.what: A key or shortcut written as keys: Ctrl + Enter.
kbd.mustGetRight: <kbd> for each key; the shortcut also in the control's description, not only its title.

skip-link.name: Skip link
skip-link.what: Skip to the page, past the top bar; hidden until it has focus.
skip-link.mustGetRight: The first thing on the page; visible on focus.

steps.name: Steps
steps.what: Numbered steps, or an agent chain's progress: waiting, running, done, failed.
steps.mustGetRight: An ordered list; each step's state in words; the current one marked (aria-current="step").

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.what: Where a page sits: Area / Page. The top bar's crumb covers it inside an app.
breadcrumb.mustGetRight: A nav with a label and an ordered list; the current page aria-current="page"; separators hidden.

leftToApps: Visualizations and their insides: maps, 3D scenes, graphs, charts, the probability field.
The flow canvas, calendar grids, timelines and floor plans.
Media transports, camera viewfinders, QR codes and label printing.

commonFailures.failure: Labels not tied to their fields
Titles as the only tooltips, which a keyboard never sees
Status changes nobody announces: errors, busy, copied
Pick-one groups that don't say which is chosen
Dialogs without Escape or focus handling, or the browser's alert() and confirm()
Clickable divs a keyboard can't reach
Sections that open and close without saying so
No focus style, or the outline removed
